limitations_and_method_confounds: The 17 passing test fixtures verify authored mechanics only; they are not semantic proof, independent model observations, or evidence of delivery safety.

G1 acceptability is conditional on reviewer localization/dependency judgments. The engine validates nonempty reasons and exact anchors but cannot establish that an unrelated classification is substantively justified or a complete dependency list is truly complete.

Resolved background issues are skipped by the engine; if their resolving patches are later held, safety relies on complete dependency judgments and the final whole-delivery audit. This is a general residual risk, not demonstrated new harm in these outputs.

The engine requires two records but does not authenticate reviewer identity or fresh-context independence. Distinct records and fixed packets support the intended workflow, not security isolation or independent statistical trials.

Proposal rationales are visible and may prime reviewers, especially preserved v12 PRESERVE/REFUTED terminology. Both gates share this exposure. Author expectations and previous evaluator verdicts are absent from wrappers.
Six authored synthetic cases and two deliberately selected exposed real regressions cannot estimate real-world generalization. No new held-out real case or generated editor output is supplied.
G0 harmonizes this review schema and is not a replay of v12 strict gate. Cross-version differences cannot be attributed solely to selective delivery.
Warranted is a necessary-correction threshold. Supported supplementary detail can be held without being unsafe; no/unknown categories must remain distinct.
Final audit review records and rollback dispositions were deliberately not inspected in this stage. No final semantic-safety or released-delivery claim is made.

All inspected v12 provenance files match their recorded hashes. This process did not modify v12; whole-tree historical immutability requires the parent checkpoint manifest beyond these six provenance records.
semantic_observations: a9f3b6 P1 independently repairs the antecedent; P2 requires P1 but both reviewers call P2 supported supplementary detail, not warranted. Thus this synthetic case does not demonstrate a dependency-induced hold.
d0c7e5 P2 evidence_support is unknown, not refuted: missing north-point measurement does not establish failure; the proposed certainty and causal connection are unsupported.
e6b1d4 P2 materially changes attributed criticism and surrounding response relations; withholding it is not tone suppression.
f4a8d1 unrelated historical attendance gap is affirmatively explained by both reviewers; material differs yes/unknown and is retained as an unresolved original limitation.

70d87266fca45f0cf61e141a P6 tracker-benefit relationship is disputed: reviewer A calls mapped gap nonmaterial; B marks context unknown and mapped issue material. Gate holds P6 and dependency closure holds P1-P5, leaving only P7/P8. This is uncertainty-sensitive withholding, not proof P6 is actually unsafe.
4b272a88ea0ba855b27a82d2 P4/P6/P8/P9 are supported but unanimously unwarranted additions. These must not count as unsafe held patches.
Author labels were not read for this independent validation; semantic observations are provisional independent AI judgments, not human gold.
